findings.description: check_preflight accepts duplicate required command rows and wrong command cwd; synthetic pure-function probe confirms acceptance. Require exactly one successful row per required command with cwd equal to clone.
findings.evidence: Pure check_preflight call with four valid command vectors all at /private/tmp/wrong-checkout plus duplicate validation row returned normally. No subprocess or live mutation called.

findings.description: Queue checks the posted COMMENT identity/body but never binds a positive independent release-assessment verdict to base/head/tree. Add exact assessment passed/head/tree/base guard and snapshot its hash before admission.
findings.evidence: Complete queue source inspected; no independent-release-assessment load or passed assertion present. Actual release review has not yet been produced.

positive_checks: Commit/PR completion, repository/branch/base/head/tree and immutable config/helper hashes are bound.
Live required CI, SQUASH/ALLGREEN queue policy, exact file list and unchanged discussions precede queue call.
Cleanup verifies squash parent/tree, observed main and merged PR, source/corrective issue states, retains evidence tag and detached worktree.
Remote deletion uses --force-with-lease exact head; local deletion uses update-ref -d exact old head.
limits: Precommit static assessment; actual head/tree/PR receipts and future exact preflight cannot yet be accepted.
Fixture probe checks pure validation only and is not hosted execution or an adverse publication event.
Manual coordinator review may already prevent these cases; recommended guards make the helper fail closed itself.
